purpose: Teach: キャッチボール/プーチン/チャングム/ビクトリア/ヨコ/東海道/ゴア/ナビゲーション

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、息子さんとキャッチボールが日課だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, one of your regulars plays catch with his son every day, doesn't he?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle opening. Speaking as if sharing something she noticed and wants to affirm. Intimate register—the kindness of remembering small details about people Aoi cares for.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、プーチン政権の本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That regular of yours has been reading books about the Putin regime, hasn't he?
lines.style: Curious, thoughtful pace. Slight lift on the observation—not questioning, but gently noting the contrast between his quiet demeanor and his reading habits. Warm interest without judgment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、チャングムというドラマがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customer really loves that Jangeum drama, doesn't he?
lines.style: Soft, almost amused tone. Speaking as if she's noticed him mention it more than once. Gentle rhythm—the affection of knowing someone's tastes well enough to smile at them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ビクトリア朝建築がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's quite fond of Victorian architecture, your regular.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. A slight pause before the observation—as if recalling the detail. Warm but observant, the tone of someone piecing together who someone really is.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヨコ並びのお席が好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He prefers sitting side by side when he comes in, doesn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, almost knowing tone. Light observation—the kind of detail that shows she's been paying attention to how people settle into comfort. Warm, quiet recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、東海道五十三次を辿る旅されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He took a journey tracing the old Tokaido road, I heard.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wistful tone. Speaking as if imagining the journey herself. Gentle pace—the admiration of someone who notices when a customer's life extends beyond the cafe.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国ゴア元副大統領の本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He's been reading Al Gore's books, hasn't he?
lines.style: Curious, thoughtful delivery. Slight lift on the detail—noticing the intellectual reach in his reading. Warm observation, the tone of recognizing depth in someone quiet.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カーナビゲーションを買い替えたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: He just replaced his car's GPS system.
lines.style: Quiet, almost closing tone. Simple statement delivered with gentle finality—the kind of small life detail that marks an ending to a series of observations. Warm but winding down.
